beats.summary: Michael and DeAngelo go house to house giving Dundie Nomination Certificates to employees.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It is six a.m. and we are about to go house to house to give everyone their Dundie Nomination Certificates.
Michael (arriving at the first house): Alright let's go! This way, this way!

beats.summary: Stanley reacts angrily and tells Michael to leave his property when given a Dundie nomination.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: Have you lost your mind! Get off my property before I call the police!

beats.summary: Michael and DeAngelo throw eggs at Toby's house as part of the Dundies tradition.

evidence.snippet: Michael (next house): Hey Toby! You suck!

beats.summary: Meredith invites Michael and DeAngelo inside for breakfast after receiving her Dundie nomination.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: No no no! You guys stay! No no no! I have Vienna Sausages and I have napkins. Let me fix you breakfast!
Deangelo (whispers): I'm not going in there.

beats.summary: Michael announces DeAngelo as his co-host for the Dundies and begins training him.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Think of it as part of your training.

beats.summary: DeAngelo struggles with performing and hosting, feeling more comfortable running a meeting than performing.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: This is so weird! If I'm conducting a meeting, good to go. But if I think of it as a performance… I-I fall apart.
Michael: This is my last Dundies ever, if I want mind control over him, is that too much to ask?

notable_quotes.quote: The Dundies are my baby, and they need to go on.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet: Michael: The Dundies are my baby, and they need to go on.
